skip.reason: Hover/Medium — the Medium column differs from Large only in height, inline padding and control font size, which default-medium pins; the hover border is pinned by hover-large.
Focus/Medium — same reasoning as Hover/Medium; the focus border and ring are pinned by focus-large.
Filled/Medium — same reasoning; the filled text colour is pinned by filled-large.
Disabled/Medium — same reasoning; the disabled fill and text are pinned by disabled-large.
Covered by the default-medium state under its Input frame 6173:5579.
Destructive/Disabled/Medium — Destructive differs from Default only in border colour, pinned by destructive-large; disabled visuals are pinned by disabled-large.
Destructive/Default/Medium — combination of destructive-large and default-medium, both covered.
Destructive/Disabled/Large — the component forces the disabled design over the variant colours, so it renders disabled-large.
Destructive/Hover/Large — combination of destructive-large and hover-large.
Destructive/Filled/Large — combination of destructive-large and filled-large.
Destructive/Focus/Large — combination of destructive-large and focus-large.

large-label.note: Figma Label text uses Desktop/Body/Small at #383838 in every variant of 159:1112.

expect.note: Figma 159:1120 sets the placeholder in Desktop/Body/Default (16/24) for Large.
Figma 159:1113 ships Assistive Text hidden by default (👁️ Assistive Text = false).
Figma 6173:5582 drops the Medium placeholder to Desktop/Body/Small (14/20).

Figma 159:1127 strokes the frame 2px #444444. A Figma stroke is inside the box and moves nothing, while a 2px CSS border would push the text in by a pixel, so the component keeps a 1px border and paints the second pixel with an inset shadow. Measured at the left edge of the rendered control: two pixels of #444444.

Figma 159:1137 strokes 2px #0058D2 with effect Focus Ring/Large/Default = 0px 0px 0px 4px rgba(204, 222, 246, 1). The ring is unstacked and maps straight across; the stroke is inside the box, so its second pixel is an inset shadow rather than a wider border, which would shift the text. Measured at the left edge: three pixels of #CCDEF6 then two of #0058D2.
Figma 159:1166 paints a filled value #121212, against the placeholder's #757575.
